stories.title: Letters from the Lower City
englishCaptions: The immutable polygon of contribution and expertise.
Beralia-01, the blighted vale.. Land of the survivors..
The tragedy of the commons that was the centralist arbiter and dispenser.
Law and Order, Crime and Punishment, Ignorance and Aversion.
Though destroyed, the upstream fed the downstream regardless.

stories.title: Crushed Rainforest Beans
englishCaptions: Imbibing this drink, is no mere taste experience,
Grasping. Craving. Attachment. I am this.
By that very noose of fear, the sword changes hands, not its thirst.
The young man is led by two Yakshas before King Yama.
You were drowned in wealth and pleasure, destroying the lives of others, heedless of your karma.
Now there shall be no clemency. Within the aeonic fire, you shall never again harm anyone.
Retribution cuts deeply, and inevitably. There is no escape.
